description:
Browse published strategies (read-only, free). Crypto-only.

strategy_type filters to one of the 16 Crank strategy types (empty = all).
sort ranks by clones|sharpe|return|sortino|win_rate|drawdown (default clones).
detail="concise" (default) trims each entry to template_id/strategy_type/
name/clone_count/is_verified/backtest_hash (template_id is the ID to chain
into clone_strategy); "full" adds description/config_template/
performance_summary/eligibility/author_wallet/created_at.
name: discover_strategies
